title: 10-Block Cuban Boxing Course — Basic Reflex
positioning: Every boxing app is a fitness product or a random combo caller. Basic Reflex is the only system that understands WHY combinations work — and can explain the biomechanics.
primarySources: Balmaseda Alburquerque, M. (2009). Escuela Cubana de Boxeo. Wanceulen Editorial.
Sagarra Caron, A. & Dominguez Garcia, J. (2007). Official Cuban Boxing Development Program.
Filimonov, V.I. et al. (1985). Boxing: Means of Physical Development.
Paul Logan — Basic Reflex original methodology (2024-2026)

modules.name: Foundation
modules.subtitle: Guard Position & Mindset
modules.cubanEquivalent: Pre-training + first weeks of Escuela Comunitaria (age 11)
learningObjectives: Hold guard position for 3x3min rounds of shadow movement without breaking form
Eyes stay above lead knuckles, chin on shoulder
Understand the contract between coach and student
Fist formation correct (no striking yet)
modules.gate: Hold guard position for 3x3min shadow rounds. Eyes above lead knuckles. Chin on shoulder. No excessive tension.
keyPrinciples: Guard is resting AND returning state
Position, not posture
Obstacle-removal pedagogy begins

citations.claim: Guard position is a position, not a posture or halt
Gaze always above knuckles of lead hand
Rear foot metatarsus only, heel 3-5cm off ground
Guard is resting AND returning state

modules.filmingNotes: Guard position from 4 angles. Common errors (chin up, guard drop, tension). Fist formation close-up.

modules.name: Level
modules.subtitle: Footwork Fundamentals
modules.cubanEquivalent: 11-12 age category — flat steps in all 4 directions
learningObjectives: Flat step in all 4 directions maintaining guard
Weight on metatarsus, smallest possible elevation
Return to guard after each displacement
Respond to directional cues within one beat for 2min continuous
modules.gate: Move in all 4 directions maintaining guard, weight on metatarsus, returns to guard after each displacement. Responds to coach cues within one beat for 2min.
keyPrinciples: Flat step is foundation of all movement
Movement IS the defense
No double flat steps

citations.claim: Flat step is foundation of all movement
Double flat steps explicitly rejected
Flat step footwork in all 4 directions at 11-12 category
No diagonal steps in early training

modules.filmingNotes: Flat step demo all 4 directions. Pendulum step. Weight distribution close-up. Common errors (crossing feet, bouncing).

modules.name: Angle
modules.subtitle: Straight Punches & Turns
learningObjectives: Jab and cross with correct weight transfer
Body variants with level change from knees
Parry and catch defenses
2-punch combinations (jab-cross)
Guard integrity under punching (12 observable behaviours)
modules.gate: 12 observable behaviours across 5 categories (Guard, Straights, Footwork+Punch, Defense, Three Functions). All 12 pass in single session.
keyPrinciples: Jab = zero weight commitment, universal setup
Kinetic chain: ground to hip to shoulder to knuckle
Three functions per technique

citations.claim: ONLY straight punches before hooks/crosses
Max 2-punch combinations at beginner level
Jab has no hip rotation, no weight commitment
Feints with arm and lead leg only
Simple and complex defense (palm parry, forearm block)
Kinetic chain: 38% legs, 37% trunk, 24% arm

modules.filmingNotes: Jab from 3 angles + slow-mo. Cross with hip rotation. Body shots with knee bend. 12 observable behaviours demonstrated. Common errors with corrections.

modules.name: Inside
modules.subtitle: Hooks, Crosses & Body Work
modules.cubanEquivalent: 13-14 age category — INTRODUCE hooks and crosses
learningObjectives: All 10 punches available
Lead hook from guard without elbow flare
All upper limb blocks + mid-forearm + torsion guard
3-punch combinations mixing straight + hook
Three functions for hooks
modules.gate: Lead hook launches from guard without elbow flare or weight shift visible at 2m. Guard hand stays. Three functions for hooks demonstrated.
keyPrinciples: GAA (lead body hook) is hardest, taught last
Counter-attacks via trunk rotation
Diagonal steps taught but used sparingly

citations.claim: Hooks and crosses introduced together at 13-14
Max 3-punch combinations after hooks introduced
GAA (lead body hook) is hardest, taught last of hooks
Short distance and body-to-body added at 13-14
Counterattacks using trunk rotation introduced
No diagonal steps in competition

modules.filmingNotes: All 10 punches demonstrated individually. Hook mechanics close-up. Lead body hook difficulty. 3-punch combo examples.

modules.name: Rhythm
modules.subtitle: Timing & Broken Rhythm
learningObjectives: Execute 4-punch combinations at varying tempos
Paradiddle pattern (jab-cross-jab-jab) at 80 BPM
Break rhythm deliberately (half-time to double-time)
Trunk defenses (DETT, DEFT, circumduction)
Call exit position before executing
modules.gate: 4-punch combo at varying tempos without losing form. Paradiddle at 80 BPM. Deliberate rhythm breaks. Exit position called before execution.
keyPrinciples: Rhythm is defining characteristic of Cuban boxing
Drumming-brain connection
Trunk defenses after upper limb mastered

citations.claim: Trunk defenses after upper limb mastered
Rhythm is a defining characteristic of Cuban boxing
citations.source: Cuban boxing tradition; Paul Logan original rudiment mappings

citations.claim: 4-5 punch combinations with defense integration at 15-16
Forward torsion dodge (DETT) — ventral flexion at 45 degrees

modules.filmingNotes: Paradiddle combo with metronome overlay. Rhythm break demo. Trunk defenses all types. Click track sync.

modules.name: Counter
modules.subtitle: Defense-to-Offense Integration
modules.cubanEquivalent: 13-14 to 15-16 transition — counter-attacks as combined actions
learningObjectives: Four outputs of correct defense understood and demonstrated
Counter fires within one beat of defensive exit
Slip-right to cross as one movement
Step-based evasion (back step, side step)
Shoulder roll (professional extension, not Cuban doctrine)
modules.gate: Demonstrates four outputs in live drill. Counter within one beat of defensive exit. Slip-right to cross = one movement.
keyPrinciples: Defense and counter are one merged action
Four outputs: counter loaded, frame disrupted, opponent exposed, position intel
Shoulder roll = divergence from Cuban doctrine

citations.claim: Defense and counter are one merged action
Step-based evasion after trunk mastered
Shoulder roll NOT Cuban doctrine — professional extension
Counter-attacks as combined actions at 13-14 to 15-16 transition

modules.filmingNotes: Four defense outputs visualized. Slip-to-counter as one movement. Shoulder roll with Cuban context note. Live drill footage.

modules.name: Pressure
modules.subtitle: Technique Under Fatigue
learningObjectives: Maintain technical quality through round 3 of focused sparring
Commitment gaps still covered under fatigue
Defensive algorithm still running when tired
Recognize fatigue degradation patterns
modules.gate: Technical quality maintained through round 3. Commitment gaps covered. Defensive algorithm running under fatigue.
keyPrinciples: No new techniques — execution under pressure
Fatigue layer: pivots drop first, head movement collapses
The psychological shift to composure

citations.claim: Maneuvering for offensive preparation at 15-16
Complete level with 30-60 official fights
Technique under fatigue: pivots drop first, head movement collapses

modules.filmingNotes: Round 1 vs Round 3 technique comparison. Fatigue degradation patterns. Conditioning drills that preserve technique.

modules.name: Escape
modules.subtitle: Ring Craft & Escape
learningObjectives: Rope escape with lateral footwork + combination
Corner escape ending in dominant ring position
Circular movement principle
No linear retreat
modules.gate: Escape from ropes and corner using lateral footwork + combination, ending in dominant position. No linear retreat.
keyPrinciples: All movements follow circular, not linear, path
The ring is a tactical element
Esquiva with lateral displacement

citations.claim: Rope/corner escape with lateral movement at 15-16
All movements must follow circular, not linear, path
Defense with backward jump
Circular esquiva for cruzado defense

modules.filmingNotes: Ring positioning overhead camera. Rope escape sequence. Corner escape. Circular movement principle visualized.

modules.name: Control
modules.subtitle: Strategy & Opponent Reading
modules.cubanEquivalent: 17-18 — emphasis shifts from repertoire to tactical application
learningObjectives: Identify opponent pattern within 30 seconds
Adjust strategy mid-round
Articulate tactical changes and reasoning
Disguised guard application
Combat against different styles
modules.gate: Identify opponent pattern within 30s. Adjust mid-round. Articulate what changed and why.
keyPrinciples: Repertoire to tactical application
Stimulus cards replace prescribed combos
The opponent reading skill

citations.claim: Emphasis shifts from repertoire to tactical application at 17-18
Combat against fast boxer, technical boxer, guard changers, deficient opponents
Disguised guard (guardia camuflada)
~100% coach independence at mastery

modules.filmingNotes: Pattern recognition demo with training partner. Mid-round adjustment narrated. Disguised guard. Style-specific strategies.

modules.name: Arena
modules.subtitle: Full Integration & Independence
modules.cubanEquivalent: 17-18 year 2 — full integration of all previous skills
learningObjectives: Three domains run as continuous algorithm
Complete independence from coach
Can coach others effectively
Solves novel ring problems without prior instruction
Playful with beginners AND killers
modules.gate: Defense, footwork, punches run as one continuous algorithm. ~100% independent. Can coach. Solves novel problems.
keyPrinciples: The algorithm that never hands off
Creation phase — invents solutions not previously learned
The predator frame arrives

citations.claim: Full integration of all previous skills at 17-18 year 2
Three domains run as continuous algorithm that never hands off
The curriculum removes obstacles; the predator frame was always there
Four phases of technical assimilation (familiarisation to creation)

modules.filmingNotes: Full sparring with narrated decision-making. Coaching demo. Novel problem-solving in ring. The integration marker.
